title: Kitty campaign: authoritative Work projection v2
description: Immutable retry of the exhausted v1 product slice on verified Builder staging-recovery base 85a43e15. Gateway remains product authority; Builder remains execution authority; no new durable Work state.

packets.title: Expose authoritative Gateway Work projection
packets.objective: Implement only the first Kitty campaign product slice. Create gateway/work_projection.py as a pure product-language mapper over gateway.builder_status.build_status_snapshot() output. Create gateway/routes/work.py with read-only GET /work and register it in gateway/routes/register.py. Do not query Builder SQLite or import Builder queue/attempt/initiative mutation modules from the Work layer; the route may obtain Builder truth only through build_status_snapshot(). One Work item maps to one Builder initiative and must retain source.kind=builder plus authoritative initiative identity. Derive product states from explicit snapshot facts: active for a live starting/running/cancel_requested run; paused for paused initiative; failed for failed initiative/packet; blocked for explicit blocker/eligibility; completed for completed initiative; ready for eligible queued work; otherwise waiting. Select current packet deterministically: live-run packet first, then initiative.next_packet, then a non-terminal packet, then most recently updated packet. Expose current packet/run, blocker, next_action, validation/review/publication evidence from persisted snapshot facts only. Because there is no durable Gateway approval identity bound to Builder initiatives, approval MUST be state=unavailable with a concrete reason containing binding; never reinterpret Builder awaiting_review as Jacob approval. Include schema_version=1, observed_at, valid_until at +30 seconds, source health, aggregate counts, and bounded items. Complete snapshot integrity is available; partial integrity is degraded with explicit reason. If build_status_snapshot() raises, GET /work returns HTTP 503 with a bounded concrete reason, never a successful empty list. Use tests to prove every state and fail-loud behavior. Change nothing outside allowed paths.
acceptance_criteria: GET /work returns schema-version-1 Work items derived only from build_status_snapshot() and the Work implementation contains no direct Builder DB/storage import or mutation path.
Tests prove active, ready, blocked, paused, failed, completed, waiting, degraded/partial-integrity, unavailable evidence, and approval-unavailable behavior.
A Builder snapshot exception produces HTTP 503 with the bounded concrete reason and never a successful empty Work payload.
Focused Work tests, Builder read-only/architecture-fitness regression tests, and Ruff all exit 0.
